The following events took place in '''987 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] [[Salto Zendar]] is hunted down, [[Skirmish in the Bandomeer hospital|attacked]], and [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]].<ref name="DOE" />
*[[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]] is nearly killed while attempting to capture Zendar, and is nursed back to health by [[Serra]].<ref name="DOE" />
*Lucia becomes Serra's bodyguard.<ref name="DOE" />

==Deaths==
*Salto Zendar on Bandomeer<ref name="DOE" />
